newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Gazprom shares rise to 2,946 roubles.
newsitem.headline: Gazprom shares rise to 2,946 roubles.

text.p: A stake of 10 million shares in Russian natural gas monopoly RAO Gazprom sold at auction on Monday at an average 2,946.93 roubles (54.5 cents) a share, up from 2,941.48 at the previous auction on September 19, the Federal Securities Corporation (FFK) said.
The starting price at the regular auction was 2,794 roubles a share and lots sold for between 2,865 roubles and 3,020 roubles a share, the FFK said in a statement.
The stake represented 0.042 percent of Gazprom's capital. The FFK said that since auctions began in March, 179.75 million shares, equivalent to 0.76 percent of the capital, had changed hands.
Prices have risen from an average 406.6 roubles a shares at the first auction on March 6.
Gazprom is Russia's biggest company by market capitalisation but its 23.6 billion shares are highly illiquid.
The company has organised the auctions to create an orderly market in its paper.
Gazprom closed at $0.335 on the Russian Trading System, down from $0.341 on Friday.
The company plans an international placement of depositary receipts in early October.
Another auction of 10 million shares will be sold on October 4 at a starting price of 2,799 roubles each.
